1:Belt:
when flag clicked
go to x: (0) y: (40)
set [speed v] to (1)
broadcast (start v)

when I receive [start v]
forever
  wait ((0.08) / (speed)) seconds
  next costume
end
1:Gift:
when flag clicked
hide

when I receive [start v]
forever
  wait (pick random (1.6) to (2.6)) seconds
  set [kind v] to (pick random (1) to (3))
  switch costume to (kind)
  go to x: (-222) y: (72)
  create clone of (myself v)
end

when I start as a clone
set [state v] to [belt]
show
forever
  if <(state) = [belt]> then
    change x by ((1.2) * (speed))
    if <(x position) > (228)> then
      set [state v] to [fall]
      repeat (12)
        change y by (-6)
        change x by (2)
        change [ghost v] effect by (8)
      end
      delete this clone
    end
  end
end
